caption: The original gates to Two-Mile-Borris cemetery, with their lovely carved stone urn finials and wrought iron, framed by the old Cypress on the right (May 2026)
One of our two blue trough planters at the cemetery layby. Locally sourced wood, made by a local tradesman, part of the cohesive village-wide planter scheme we're rolling out (May 2026)

The parking layby in front of the cemetery, with our two blue planters either side framing the spot. The Norman Blackcastle ruin is visible just beyond on the right, marking the western edge of the village (May 2026)
Another view of the cemetery layby planter against the stone wall. We're delighted with how the cohesive blue scheme ties the village together (May 2026)
The derelict property across from the cemetery, with hedges and trees grown out over the footpath. We're working to identify the owner so we can ask for the overgrowth to be cut back (May 2026)
